svg.text: Modular Diffusion Toolbox - Pipelines + Models + Schedulers - huggingface.co/docs/diffusers
L1 - Applications + Model Families (multimodal diffusion inference and fine-tuning)
L2 - DiffusionPipeline Layer (end-to-end bundles - Hub load/save - component registry)
Each component in separate Hub subfolder
Unbundle pipeline for custom denoising loops
L3 - Model Components (ModelMixin - ConfigMixin - modular neural building blocks)
Flow models may skip separate VAE path
True CFG distill models skip dual pass
PeftAdapterMixin for LoRA at model level
Training: use models directly not pipeline
L4 - Scheduler Layer (SchedulerMixin - denoising algorithm plug-ins - no learned params)
DDPM - DDIM - PNDM - LMS - Euler / Ancestral
LCM / TCD for few-step distilled checkpoints
One scheduler algo per Python file in schedulers/
from_config() loads JSON config only - no weights
L5 - Adapters + Weight Loading (PEFT LoRA - ControlNet - hot-swap inference)
FA3 + torch.compile + FP8 + T5 NF4 quant
L6 - Quantization + Memory Optimization (PipelineQuantizationConfig - per-component backends)
gguf - diffusers vs transformers BnB split
Quantize transformer + T5 separately from CLIP
sequential offload for tight VRAM budgets
L7 - Ecosystem + Backends (PyTorch-first - Hub - Transformers/Accelerate/PEFT stack)
Core Denoising Loop (Stable Diffusion / FLUX pattern)
Unbundle pipeline: encode prompt - init latents - iterate scheduler steps - decode image
Step 0: Tokenize prompt - text_encoder(s) - prompt_embeds (+ negative for CFG)
Step 1: VAE encode (img2img) OR sample random latents shape [B,C,H/8,W/8]
Step 3: FOR t in timesteps: noise_pred = unet/transformer(latents,t,embeds) - scheduler.step()
Step 4: VAE decode latents to pixels - post-process - safety check (optional)
Swap scheduler at runtime: pipeline.scheduler = LMSDiscreteScheduler.from_config(...)
ControlNet: parallel forward adds residual to UNet skip connections per timestep
Three-class toolbox - pipelines for convenience - models/schedulers for composition
pipelines/ (per-paper) - models/ - schedulers/ - loaders/ - quantizers/ - utils/
Philosophy: default simple pipeline - power users unbundle and write custom loops
Design Position (modular diffusion toolbox - pipeline convenience + composable primitives)
DiffusionPipeline bundles components - swap schedulers/adapters freely - Hub-native load/save
Quickstart: pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(...) - image = pipe(prompt, num_inference_steps=28).images[0]
Sources: huggingface.co/docs/diffusers - github.com/huggingface/diffusers - Philosophy + Quickstart + Quantization docs
